tools.name: editor_capture_window
tools.description: Capture a desktop window, including Slate/UMG, to a PNG. Uses native Windows capture and best-effort macOS/Linux capture. Optional window_title selects a top-level window; falls back to the UE4Editor main window when that title is not open.

tools.name: editor_create_object
editor_delete_object
editor_update_object
get_unreal_engine_path
tools.description: Get the active Unreal Engine root path from the connected editor session

tools.name: get_unreal_project_path
tools.description: Get the active Unreal project file path from the connected editor session

tools.name: get_unreal_version
tools.description: Get the active Unreal Engine version string from the connected editor session

tools.name: manage_actor
tools.description: Actor tool namespace for listing, searching, spawning, deleting, transforming, and inspecting level actors.

tools.name: manage_ai
tools.description: Inspect AI controllers, pawns, behavior trees, blackboards, navmesh actors, and perception; toggle debugger views; create behavior trees and blackboards; add, remove, and list blackboard keys; inspect and run behavior trees.

tools.name: manage_animation
tools.description: Animation authoring namespace for AnimBlueprint AnimGraphs and state machines, AnimSequence notifies/curves/markers, and AnimMontage slots/sections/segments/notifies.

tools.name: manage_asset
tools.description: Asset tool namespace for listing, searching, inspecting, exporting, validating, duplicating, renaming, moving, deleting, saving, and folder-management actions.

tools.name: manage_audio
tools.description: Audio tool namespace for importing audio files, searching audio assets, and inspecting their asset metadata.

tools.name: manage_audit
tools.description: Read-only project audits for required plugins, remote-execution config, Vite cvars, and a consolidated summary.

tools.name: manage_batch
tools.description: Run a sequential list of MCP tool calls in one request. Each call uses the normal namespace/direct safety guard. Recursion into manage_batch, manage_stack, and manage_debug.panic is rejected. Not atomic; end write batches with explicit save actions.

tools.name: manage_blueprint
tools.description: Blueprint tool namespace for Blueprint creation, component editing, graph/event/function/variable authoring, Construction Script nodes, compilation, and summary actions.

tools.name: manage_build
tools.description: Read-only build environment audit and command planning for ViteSetup, UBT, RunUAT, DDC commandlets, cache wipe, and debloat. Build execution is intentionally deferred.

tools.name: manage_code
tools.description: Read-first C++ and Live Coding tooling: status, project-source read/write with backups, source inventory, build/log inspection, automation-test inventory, and supervised compile/run previews.

tools.name: manage_data
tools.description: Data tool namespace for searching data assets, creating common data containers, and inspecting their asset metadata.

tools.name: manage_ddgi
tools.description: Inspect, validate, and edit NVIDIA RTXGI/DDGI volumes with native undo/redo.

tools.name: manage_debug
tools.description: Editor health, plugin availability, supervisor status, log tails, recent scripts, and panic/reset controls.

tools.name: manage_editor
tools.description: Editor tool namespace for run_python, console capture, enriched project/map inspection, PIE lifecycle (start_pie/stop_pie/is_pie_running) and expectations (pie_expect), screenshots, asset tab open/close/focus/list, prelude reload, and camera movement.

tools.name: manage_editor_tool
tools.description: Editor-tool namespace for Editor Utility Widget Blueprint creation and opening as a docked editor tab.

tools.name: manage_effect
tools.description: Effects tool namespace for spawning debug-shape actors, assigning materials, tinting them, and deleting them.

tools.name: manage_gas
tools.description: GAS tool namespace for searching gameplay-ability-related assets and inspecting their asset metadata.

tools.name: manage_geometry
tools.description: Geometry tool namespace for all preset builders: wall, maze, pyramid, bridge, town, house, mansion, tower, suspension bridge, aqueduct, castle fortress, arch, and staircase.

tools.name: manage_history
tools.description: Action history with native editor undo/redo and semantic undo metadata.

tools.name: manage_input
tools.description: Input tool namespace for creating classic UE4 input mappings.

tools.name: manage_level
tools.description: Level tool namespace for map lifecycle inspection, actor listing, world outliner inspection, and map info.

tools.name: manage_lighting
tools.description: Lighting tool namespace for spawning common light actors, transforming them, and inspecting level lighting state.

tools.name: manage_material
tools.description: Material tool namespace for listing/applying materials and tinting material instances, plus Material and MaterialFunction expression-graph authoring.

params.name: static_switches
params.description: Static switch values keyed by parameter name. true/false, 1/0, yes/no, on/off are accepted.

tools.name: manage_navigation
tools.description: Navigation tool namespace for spawning navigation volumes and proxies plus basic map inspection actions.

tools.name: manage_object
tools.description: Generic UObject control: describe schema, read/write any property path, call functions, spawn by class path, destroy, duplicate, and run transactional batches.

params.description: Handle from a previous result: 'uev:<kind>:<object path>' is stable (survives releases, PIE transitions and editor restarts). Legacy 'obj_<n>' is still accepted but only stays valid until the retained-object registry is released.

tools.name: manage_physics
tools.description: Physics tool namespace for spawning physics-enabled Blueprints, editing component physics, applying forces and impulses in PIE, setting collision profile/response and CharacterMovement properties, and running a bounded PIE drop test.

tools.name: manage_profile
tools.description: Profiling capture with stats-file artifacts, artifact listing/inspection, log comparison, frame-budget checks, and supervised profilegpu capture.

tools.name: manage_query
tools.description: Find objects in the level or assets by class, label, tag, component or asset reference. Each result carries a stable 'uev:<kind>:<object path>' handle for manage_object plus the legacy 'native_handle' (obj_<n>).

tools.name: manage_sequence
tools.description: Sequence tool namespace for creating, searching, inspecting, and editing LevelSequence assets, including bindings, tracks, sections, keys, camera cuts, playback ranges, and speed-track time calculations.

tools.name: manage_skeleton
tools.description: Skeleton tool namespace for searching Skeleton and SkeletalMesh assets and inspecting their metadata.

tools.name: manage_source_control
tools.description: Source-control tool namespace for provider inspection and file or package source-control operations.

tools.name: manage_splines
tools.description: Spline tool namespace for spawning a spline-host actor or Blueprint and then transforming or deleting it.

tools.name: manage_stack
tools.description: Bring the Unreal editor, supervisor, and control API up on demand, attach to a running editor, inspect readiness, or stop the processes this server started.

tools.name: manage_system
tools.description: Polling helper namespace: wait_for repeats another tool action until a dotted JSON path matches an expected value.

tools.name: manage_texture
tools.description: Texture tool namespace for searching texture assets, importing image files as textures, and reading their asset metadata.

tools.name: manage_tools
tools.description: Tool-namespace registry for listing registered tool namespaces and describing supported actions. Use this as the discovery entry point for the namespace-first MCP surface.

tools.name: manage_vite
tools.description: Unreal Engine Vite renderer inspection and controlled writes: cvars, render state, compile switches, presets, project audit, allowlisted console commands, and screenshots.

tools.name: manage_volumes
tools.description: Volume tool namespace for spawning common engine volumes and applying delete or transform actions.

tools.name: manage_widget
tools.description: Widget tool namespace for UMG Blueprint creation, widget-tree inspection, widget-tree edits, CanvasPanel root normalization, and viewport spawning actions. Use inspect_tree to verify designer contents, add_child_widget for nested layout work, and ensure_canvas_root when absolute CanvasPanel positioning is required.
